Building a house on Atlantic Avenue would leave me with $197. If I roll a 9 and land on the B&O Railroad, I would need to sell a house at half price for $75 to cover the $200 rent. Player 3 has hotels on light blue and $3,214, so they are still dangerous. The path to victory is making yellow and possibly orange deadly enough to force player 3 into bankruptcy. Player 3 can land on my New York Avenue for only $16, or on Atlantic Avenue for $44, before reaching my light blue hotels. I am currently on space 15, so I must lap the board before I can collect rent from those hotels.

Player 1 can land on my yellow properties this turn from the B&O Railroad. Player 2 is currently on Marvin Gardens and will not hit yellow again until they lap the board. Player 3 can only land on Atlantic Avenue from Virginia this turn, then must wait for another full orbit.
